elements.requirement: Where the amount of a debt to which this Part applies is referable to a period of time, the total amount payable to an employee in respect of that debt shall not exceed £751 in respect of any one week.
elements.quote: The total amount payable to an employee in respect of any debt to which this Part applies, where the amount of the debt is referable to a period of time, shall not exceed— (a) £751 in respect of any one week

elements.requirement: Where the amount of a debt to which this Part applies is referable to a period of time shorter than a week, the total amount payable to an employee in respect of that debt shall not exceed an amount bearing the same proportion to £751 as that shorter period bears to a week.
elements.quote: in respect of a shorter period, an amount bearing the same proportion to £751 as that shorter period bears to a week

thresholds.what: maximum total amount payable to an employee in respect of any debt for any one week
thresholds.quote: £751 in respect of any one week

thresholds.what: period for which the £751 maximum amount payable applies
